# PMS — Project Management System

> AI-powered construction project management: BOQ analysis, contracts, costs, risks, and execution planning.

PMS helps engineers and contractors analyze Bills of Quantities, manage FIDIC-style contracts, track costs and risks, generate progress certificates, and produce AI-assisted execution plans.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the PMS workspace and entry points.
- [About](/about): What PMS is, the team behind it, and the technologies used.
- [Changelog](/changelog): Recent product updates and release notes.
